# White Rabbit Los Angeles

> Bespoke magic and mentalism entertainment for luxury events, led by magician Scott Syme. Based in Los Angeles, available nationwide.

## About

White Rabbit Los Angeles delivers unforgettable close-up magic, mentalism, and parlor shows for corporate events, weddings, private parties, and luxury celebrations. Founded by Scott Syme, a member of the world-famous Magic Castle® in Hollywood, White Rabbit has performed for brands including Netflix, Disney, Paramount, Morgan Stanley, Rolls-Royce, Rivian, Lionsgate, and Soho House.

Scott Syme is a professional magician and mentalist based in Los Angeles, California. He specializes in close-up interactive magic, psychological mentalism, and curated parlor shows for groups of 20 to 200+. He has been featured on America's Got Talent and has performed at over 500 private and corporate events.

## Services

- **Corporate Event Magic**: Close-up magic and mentalism for Fortune 500 galas, product launches, holiday parties, and team-building events.
- **Wedding Entertainment**: Cocktail hour and reception magic that gives guests a shared, unforgettable experience.
- **Private Party Magic**: Bespoke entertainment for birthdays, dinner parties, anniversaries, and intimate celebrations.
- **Close-Up Magic**: Interactive magic and mentalism performed directly in guests' hands during cocktail hours and mingling.
- **Private Magic Show (Parlor Show)**: A curated 45-minute theatrical magic experience for groups of 20 to 120.
